On the sturdy wooden workbench: gleaming sheets of specialty metallic pearlescent paper (giấy ánh kim 180gsm) shimmering under light, accompanied by sample wedding invitation cards.

Young East Asian female artisan matching <IMAGE_REF_0> wearing the muted pale lavender / soft lilac relaxed short-sleeved top with tonal floral embroidery on the chest in <IMAGE_REF_1>.
